profile.headline: Middleware and Infrastructure Software Engineer at Johnson & Johnson
profile.jobTitle: Robotics & Digital Solutions: Middleware and Infrastructure Software Engineer

positions.title: Robotics & Digital Solutions: Middleware and Infrastructure Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Headed the software side of power management, whose responsibilities include triggering graceful shutdown under specified conditions and battery status notification.
• Expanded the system's data upload functionality to include upload prioritization and continuous upload.
• Lent Python support to those in the testing team by laying the foundation for their automated tests and resolving any preexisting/novel bugs.

positions.title: Video Game Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Used the Unity game engine to setup most the environment (stage design, audio and dialogue managers, UI), character hitboxes and animations, and cutscenes.
• Incorporated Object Oriented Design to develop character move sets and character-player interaction in C# (https://bitbucket.org/jhu_smash_bros/2d-smash/src/master/).
• Produced YouTube videos to showcase the project’s progress (https://youtu.be/eSSJFNMA8VQ/).

positions.title: Augmented Reality Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Garnered the praise of some executives from Stryker, a medical tech firm, after giving our demonstration at a fair.
• Using the Unity engine and the Microsoft HoloLens, led the development of an augmented reality version of Twister, a project meant to set up the basis of an educational program for surgical trainees.
• As the most proficient C# coder, planned and developed the gaming environment, such as sphere placement, and other UI elements (hand tracking, timer-based health system) to reflect current, fast-paced gaming (https://bitbucket.org/tae14/ar-twister/src/master/).
• Summary: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1TDmTMC-vx8f2z7R3qs09txafinCQ6x9q/

positions.title: Kendo Club President
positions.description:
• Revitalized a dying club by transforming it from a hobby/interest group into a competitive martial arts club.
• Established the JHU Kendo Club's very first official instructor (Sean Kim, 6th Dan/Renshi from Washington Kendo Dojo).
• Guaranteed the club's involvement in the kendo sphere (tournament participation and ranking up ceremonies) by setting up its membership into the South Eastern US Kendo Federation.
• Helped organize fundraisers (link provided) and manage resources (replacing worn out equipment and procuring new equipment for newcomers).

positions.title: Web Security Software Engineer
positions.description: • Redeveloped Google’s Cross-Site Scripting Game (https://xss-game.appspot.com/) by removing as many of its vulnerabilities as possible in order to not only produce a more secure site but to also expose myself to web security and web development in CSS/JS and Flask (https://github.com/tae-k/xxs-game-redevelopment/).

positions.title: Medical Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project 1/2: Burn Severity Analyzer
• Designed and created a portable device capable of imaging the burn severity on skin via multispectral image analysis.
• Led the development of the device’s functionality in Arduino with imaging done via the ArduCAM by using automated light color shifting and automated camera picture taking.
• Presentation: https://drive.google.com/open?id=11mLHMboshRwyhioMB47zHKOrbpBDbTF3/

Project 2/2: Mammographic CAD System
• Using MATLAB, developed a viable mammographic CAD system capable diagnosing masses found in mammographic images.
• Implemented image pixel intensity frequency distribution algorithms based on polar histogram distribution patterns and the peak frequency intensity value ranges that were able to detect, diagnose, and mask the masses found in the images.
• Report: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1wEqpjciCL0IyYFp-ppNeoRplTe2IRiZA/

positions.title: Video Game Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created a 2D Top-Down Action-Adventure game (4 levels, 1 boss stage) featuring a king who must defend his castle from an alien invasion in C++ and SDL 2.0 (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1NVdzCBPwleSCAh1-dn_iC0rNQcE0QhdK/).
• Developed character movement and action (running and sword swinging), random enemy roaming, boss activity, cut scenes, and other interactive modules (traps, power-ups, health and stamina bars) to maintain user attention (https://github.com/tae-k/royal-retribution/).
• As this was my very first video game design project, was also in charge of debugging any glitches found in the game, which required repeated extensive playthroughs.

honors.title: Hodson Trust Scholarship
honors.description: "Hodson Trust Scholarships are awarded on the basis of academic and personal achievement and leadership, and provide approximately two-thirds of the annual tuition costs for around 20 exceptional first-year students. These scholarships are automatically renewed for three subsequent years of full-time undergraduate study provided the recipient maintains a 3.0 grade point average" (http://www.hodsontrust.org/hopkins.html).
honors.issuer: Issued by Johns Hopkins University · Aug 2015
